name: Downtown to Ward Lake
blurb: The first fundable spine: from the downtown hillside to the Ward Lake recreation area, stitching trails residents already use across City, Borough, and Forest Service land.

name: Ward Lake to Lunch Creek
blurb: North from Ward through Connell Lake toward Lunch Creek — the interior connection that turns scattered USFS trails into a through-route instead of a set of dead ends.

name: Deer Mountain to Silvis Lake
blurb: The south-island ridge: a surveyed-later connection from the Deer Mountain National Recreation Trail to Silvis Lake, so the high country is a network instead of a single out-and-back.

name: North Tongass coastal
blurb: A coastal walking connection along North Tongass — Refuge Cove toward Settler's Cove — so the highway is not the only way to move between the north-end communities and the interior trails.
